results.title: Venues – IJCAI 2026
excerpts:
# Venues
## Main Conference: Congress Centrum Bremen
The main IJCAI-ECAI 2026 conference will take place from **18 to 21 August 2026** at the Congress Centrum Bremen ( https://congress-bremen.com/en/ ) (CCB), a centrally located congress venue in the heart of Bremen.
Inside, the congress building offers postmodern conference spaces with generous natural light for plenary talks, technical sessions and networking opportunities.

...

Located next to Bürgerpark and within walking distance of the historic city centre, the venue is easy to reach by public transport and offers convenient access to the city centre.
The Maritim Hotel Bremen is directly connected to the Congress Centrum, and further hotel options are close by.

...

### **Workshop & Tutorials: University of Bremen**
The workshops and tutorials of IJCAI-ECAI 2026 will take place from **15 to 17 August 2026** on the campus of the University of Bremen ( https://www.uni-bremen.de/en/ ), before the main conference.
Located north of the city centre, the University of Bremen is connected to Bremen Central Station and Bremen Airport by tram line 6. The central campus stop, Universität/Zentralbereich, provides direct access to the main university area. Here you will also find the registration desk.

# Venue
The 29th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence and the 17th Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-PRICAI 2020) will be held in Yokohama, Japan.
There are three venues for the IJCAI-PRICAI 2020 Conference.
Saturday, 11 July: Pacifico Yokohama North, TKP GC Premium Yokohama Landmark Tower, and TKP Garden City Yokohama for Workshop and Tutorial.
Sunday 12 – Monday 13 July: Pacifico Yokohama North for Workshop and Tutorial.
Tuesday 14 – 17 July: Pacifico Yokohama North for Main Conference.
